name: YouTube
description: Read a channel's own videos with their view, like and comment counts, look up stats for specific videos, search YouTube, and read or reply to comments.
intentHints: how are my youtube videos doing
summarize the comments on my latest video
search youtube for videos about X
_authNote: OAuth endpoints, scopes and the client secret ref are PLATFORM-OWNED (clarity-api, integrations-v2/config/oauth-configs.ts). YouTube uses its own Google Cloud project rather than the shared Gmail client, so its scope changes cannot re-open the verification the email and calendar integrations depend on.

providedTools.description: The connected channel's own videos, newest first, each with views, likes and comment count. Counts are null rather than zero when the channel hides them.
Stats for specific videos. Takes `video_id` for one or `video_ids` for many, and answers for up to fifty in a single request, so ask for all of them at once rather than one call each.

Search public YouTube videos. `order` is relevance, date, viewCount, rating or title. This is the most quota-expensive call YouTube offers, so search once and work from the results rather than searching repeatedly.
Top-level comments on a video, with author, text, likes and how many replies each has. Returns each comment's id, which is what reply_comment takes as parent_id.

Reply to a comment as the connected channel. `parent_id` is a comment id from list_comments. Needs write access, which is granted separately; until then this answers that the scope is missing rather than failing silently.
